purpose: Join family-specific route blocker localization to predictive intervention timing without allowing either authority to invent the other's physics.
invariants: Route safety owns blocker localization and route-family hazard semantics.
Predictive safety owns whether certified intervention can complete before the conservative blocker or commitment boundary.
A route blocker distance may be consumed as predictive input only when route safety marks it as applicable to the certified blocker.
Missing blocker geometry, progress rate, timing, or family evidence remains UNRESOLVED rather than becoming zero.
PRECOMMIT and PORTAL_ADMISSION families do not receive fabricated continuous route velocities.
Predictive PASS does not erase a route REJECTED disposition; route ADMISSIBLE does not erase predictive BLOCK.
provenanceRequirements: Record which blocker field supplied the predictive distance.
Record whether the distance was conservative, nominal, or unavailable.
Record all explicit overrides separately from route-derived evidence.
